caroline.description: Video player: plays a video or a folder of videos from the SD card; pause, skip, seek

tools.name: now_playing
tools.description: What plays now: the video, the time, the place in the queue, the order

tools.name: play
tools.description: Plays a video file (with the rest of its folder after it) or a folder of videos (with its subfolders)

tools.name: previous
tools.description: The previous video, or the start of this one

tools.name: stop
tools.description: Stops and goes back to the start

tools.name: seek
tools.description: Moves within the video by this many seconds (negative: back)
